title: GTA 6 Has Its Own TikTok Inside Your Phone 📱 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6's in-game phone has a feed of short videos and posts with scarily realistic comment sections, and one streamer even goes live from inside a car trunk. Rockstar made the phone a real object in the characters' hands, but Jason and Lucia can't post their own photos. Fans also report that scrolling while driving makes your car harder to control.
